# Sriram Chidambaram Adaikkappan

> Personal portfolio site. Covers Math Olympiad results, robotics and STEM projects, general knowledge (subjects, languages, books), and speed cubing stats.

## Sections

- [About](https://sriramc.is-a.dev/#about): Introduction.
- [Math & Logical Reasoning](https://sriramc.is-a.dev/#academics): National and international Olympiad rankings and awards.
- [Robotics & Hardware Innovations](https://sriramc.is-a.dev/#projects): Robotics and STEM hardware projects, including a humanoid robot and a TDS water-quality meter.
- [Knowledge](https://sriramc.is-a.dev/#knowledge): Subjects and skills, languages spoken, and books read or in progress.
- [Speed Cubing Metrics](https://sriramc.is-a.dev/#cubing): 3x3x3 speedcubing personal best and average.

## Notes

- Single-page static site, no separate pages or API.
- Source: https://github.com/sriramchidambaram-source/personal-portfolio
